contract: GET /api/libraries/:id/podcast-titles is admin-only and answers {podcasts: [{title, itunesId, libraryItemId, libraryId}]} for every podcast whose library item belongs to the library, without tag or explicit filtering; a library with no podcasts answers an empty array. 401 without a token, 403 for a non-admin or an admin without the library, 404 for an unknown library id.
evidence: go-backend/testmachine/scenarios/podcast_feed: the three title scenarios pass against pinned upstream in two consecutive full packet runs
exceptions: The itunesId of a podcast created by the OPML import is the empty string rather than null because PodcastManager.createPodcastsFromFeedUrls posts itunesId ""; the scenario pins that value.

invariants.contract: GET /api/libraries/:id/podcast-titles answers 401 without a token, 403 for a listener and for a finisher, 403 for an admin whose librariesAccessible does not contain the library, and 404 for an unknown library id.

An admin request answers {podcasts} with one entry per podcast of the library carrying the stored title, the stored itunesId (null when never set), the library item id the client opens and the libraryId; the audiobook library answers an empty podcasts array.
